conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), the Comfort Club Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Standard includes two seasonal tune-ups a year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both Standard and Plus members get $500 off any full system replacement.

The 2026 Fee Schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) lists Comfort Club at $189 per year for one system, not $149, and Comfort Club Plus at $269 per year.

conversation.text: I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a warranty claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).
Since the unit was installed last year, it falls within the 2-year labor warranty that Meridian provides on all full system installations.
Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive an extended 5-year labor warranty instead (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand.
Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install, and registration is required for the full parts warranty term.

For most brands listed, such as Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Rheem and American Standard, the compressor and parts are covered for 10 years and the heat exchanger for 20 years, while Goodman's heat exchanger is covered for a limited lifetime.
Manufacturer warranties cover the part only, and labor to replace a warranted part is billable after the Meridian labor warranty expires (Warranty Policy, Manufacturer parts warranty).
The facts don't say whether your specific failure would be covered, which is what the diagnostic determines.
